Title: INCIA Natural Deodorant for Sensitive Skin
Body (HTML): INCIA Natural Deodorant for Sensitive Skin is a 100% natural roll-on deodorant specially formulated for those with sensitive or easily irritated underarms. Powered by potassium alum (a natural mineral salt) and soothing aloe vera, it neutralises odour-causing bacteria without blocking pores, leaving you feeling fresh all day. Key benefits:- Natural mineral salt (alum) — powerful antibacterial action without synthetic aluminium- Aloe vera soothes and hydrates sensitive underarm skin- Does not clog pores — allows natural perspiration- No stains on clothing- Safe to use during pregnancy and breastfeeding- Can be applied immediately after shaving- Free from alcohol, parabens and synthetic fragrances- Cruelty-free and vegan Why natural deodorant? Body odour is caused when sweat mixes with bacteria — not by sweat itself. Conventional deodorants often contain synthetic aluminium salts that block sweat glands entirely and can irritate sensitive skin. INCIA's alum-based formula works by creating an antibacterial environment that prevents odour at the source, without harsh chemicals. Aloe vera in this formula has anti-inflammatory and hydrating properties, making it ideal for skin that is prone to irritation from shaving or friction. For best results, apply the evening before on clean, dry underarms. 50ml roll-on.
